# Project 33: Personal Budget Dashboard

**Category:** 5. Finance, Data & Decision Support
**Status:** Pending. Not started; work begins only on the explicit command `Start Project 33`.

## Brief (from the source PDF)

Organizes income and expenses into categories and shows spending patterns.

> Original: Income aur expenses ko categories mein organize karke spending patterns dikhata hai.

### Core features

- Monthly budget
- Category breakdown
- Savings goals
